episodes.title: Daria in Esteemsters
episodes.summary: The Morgendorffers move to Lawndale, where Quinn becomes a member of the popular Fashion Club and Daria meets an equally cynical artist named Jane during a self-esteem class taught by their neurotic, wimpy English teacher, Mr. O'Neill.

episodes.title: The Invitation
episodes.summary: To Quinn's horror, Daria is also invited to Brittany's party after helping her solve an art class problem, and Jane tags along.

episodes.title: College Bored
episodes.summary: The Morgendorffers visit Middleton College – Jake and Helen's alma mater, where Quinn goes to a frat party and Daria finds brisk business writing term papers.

episodes.title: Café Disaffecto
episodes.summary: Daria reluctantly becomes involved in the opening of Lawndales's new student coffeehouse. She also becomes involved in its closing.

episodes.title: Malled
episodes.summary: Daria's economic class takes a field trip to a new enormous mall. Daria is sickened by the teeming masses. She discovers Quinn playing hooky in the mall. Daria is no longer sick.

episodes.title: This Year's Model
episodes.summary: Lawndale High has a couple of visitors, claiming to be modeling scouts looking for the next Christy Turlington. Quinn and Brittany have high hopes. Daria and Jane are revolted by their presence.

episodes.title: The Lab Brat
episodes.summary: Daria and Kevin are forces to work as lab partners in science class. The homework consists of teaching a mouse tricks. Daria does all of the work, of course, while Kevin watches football on TV and flirts with Quinn.

episodes.title: Pinch Sitter
episodes.summary: Quinn gets Daria to baby sit for her. Daria, who has no interest in being an authority figure since she doesn't respect authority, is stuck with two well-behaved "PC" kids who say things like "We don't like commercials – they lie."

episodes.title: Too Cute
episodes.summary: Quinn decides she needs cosmetic surgery, and drags Daria to the doctor with her. She is happy to consult with Quinn, but very interested in Daria, whom she views as a long-term project and potential masterpiece.

episodes.title: The Big House
episodes.summary: The annual teachers-verses-deejays roller hockey game is coming, and there is a good chance that the students will get to see Mr. Demartino die of an aneurysm during the game – but Daria is going to miss it because she is grounded by her parents.

episodes.title: Road Worrier
episodes.summary: Daria and Jane hitch a ride to the "Alternapalooza" festival with Jane's brother Trent (Daria's heartthrob) and his friend Jesse. Their van doesn't work so well, but it's an interesting trip.

episodes.title: The Teachings of Don Jake
episodes.summary: Jake's stress level is reaching critical mass, so the Morgendorffers go on a camping trip. Like that's gonna help.

episodes.title: The Misery Chick
episodes.summary: Lawndale high is a buzz with homecoming preparations. The quarterback who lead the team to the state championship three years ago is returning! Then he has a tragic accident, which ironically leads to sudden popularity for our Daria.

episodes.title: Arts 'n' Crass
episodes.summary: Daria reluctantly gets involved in a poster contest in which she and Jane depict "Student Life At The Dawn Of The Millennium."...rather negatively.

episodes.title: The Daria Hunter
episodes.summary: The students of Lawndale High go on a paintballing trip to learn about history, psychology and shooting people.

episodes.title: Quinn the Brain
episodes.summary: A (very) brief burst of intellectual activity gets her an instant reputation as a "brain."

episodes.title: I Don't
episodes.summary: Daria and her family participate in the strange and frightening ritual known as a family wedding.

episodes.title: That Was Then, This is Dumb
episodes.summary: Daria and Jane accompany Trent to a flea market, while Jake and Helen's old college drop in for a reunion weekend.

episodes.title: Monster
episodes.summary: When Daria and Jane are assigned to make a student film, they decide to record a day in the life of Quinn.

episodes.title: The New Kid
episodes.summary: Daria gets roped into participating in the Lawndale High yearbook and meets Ted, who up to now has been schooled entirely at home.

episodes.title: Gifted
episodes.summary: Daria and Jodie are invited to visit a school for the gifted and talented.

episodes.title: Ill
episodes.summary: Daria develops a mysterious rash and has to check into the hospital for tests.

episodes.title: Fair Enough
episodes.summary: The school stages a medieval fair to raise money for a new library roof.

episodes.title: See Jane Run
episodes.summary: Jane surprises everyone by deciding to try out for the school track team. Daria makes no such surprising decision.

episodes.title: Pierce Me
episodes.summary: When Daria agrees to help Trent find a birthday present for Jane, they somehow end up at a piercing parlor offering a two-for-one special. Hmm.

episodes.title: Write Where It Hurts
episodes.summary: Daria is assigned to write a short story turning people she knows into fictional characters. Like they're not unbelieving enough already.

episodes.title: Daria!
episodes.summary: The threat of a Lawndale hurricane causes people to start singing and dancing!

episodes.title: Through a Lens Darkly
episodes.summary: Daria debates whether to get contact lenses.

episodes.title: The Old and the Beautiful
episodes.summary: During Volunteer Week, Daria reads to old people - who are thrown into a depression by her voice.

episodes.title: Depth Takes a Holiday
episodes.summary: A fantasy show wherein Daria and Jane have to convince Christmas, Halloween and Guy Fawkes Day to return to Holiday Island.

episodes.title: Daria Dance Party
episodes.summary: Quinn gets roped into organizing the school dance; she fobs the job off on Jane.

episodes.title: The Lost Girls
episodes.summary: The publisher of a "Savvy"-like teen magazine comes to Lawndale to hang out with Daria.

episodes.title: It Happened One Nut
episodes.summary: Daria is forced to work side by side with Kevin at a mall nut stand.

episodes.title: Lane Miserables
episodes.summary: All the prodigal Lanes come home at once, forcing Jane to temporarily move in with Daria.

episodes.title: Jake of Hearts
episodes.summary: Jake's recovery from a mild heart attack is complicated by the arrival of his mother, a woman with old-fashioned ideas that clash wildly with the Morgendorffer women, particularly Helen.

episodes.title: Speedtrapped
episodes.summary: Daria and Quinn have to take a road trip to bail Jane and Trent out on a traffic violation.

episodes.title: The Lawndale File
episodes.summary: A series of strange events leads Daria to wonder whether aliens have take over the town.

episodes.title: Just Add Water
episodes.summary: The whole school goes on a mandatory-voluntary harbor cruise to raise money via casino gambling.

episodes.title: Jane's Addition
episodes.summary: Jane starts dating a guy, to the annoyance of her misanthropic friend Daria.

episodes.title: Partner's Complaint
episodes.summary: For an economics project, Daria and Jodie team up to start a company.

episodes.title: Antisocial Climbers
episodes.summary: While on a hill trek, Daria's class gets caught in an unexpected snowstorm.

episodes.title: A Tree Grows in Lawndale
episodes.summary: A football injury sidelines star quarterback Kevin, forcing him to re-evaluate his life for a minute or two.

episodes.title: Murder, She Snored
episodes.summary: A history test is stolen, Daria alone can solve the crime - provided she doesn't wake up.

episodes.title: The F Word (aka Fail)
episodes.summary: Mr. O'Neill finds a way to make self-discovery even more painful than usual.

episodes.title: I Loathe a Parade
episodes.summary: An ill-timed trip to the store results in Daria's becoming trapped in Lawndale's homecoming parade.

episodes.title: Of Human Bonding
episodes.summary: When Helen has to cancel out of a business junket with Jake, guess who is coerced into taking her place?

episodes.title: Psycho Therapy
episodes.summary: The Morgendorffers visit a "spa for the soul" to get their psyches massaged.

episodes.title: Mart of Darkness
episodes.summary: There's this big warehouse store, see, and Daria needs bootlaces…

episodes.title: Legends of the Mall
episodes.summary: Is Lawndale a pretty little suburb, or an unholy nexus of evil haunted by the tortured denizens of the Beyond?

episodes.title: Groped by an Angel
episodes.summary: Quinn discovers her spiritual side and we all have to live through it.

episodes.title: Fire!
episodes.summary: When Jake accidentally sets fire to the kitchen, the Morgendorffers stay in a hotel until repairs are made. Daria elects to stay at Jane's, where she gets to know Tom better, causing Jane to suspect that there's more going on than meets the eye.

episodes.title: Dye! Dye! My Darling
episodes.summary: Jane's latest artistic endeavour is to paint tiger stripes in her hair, for which she recruits Daria's assistance. Botching the job gets her in hot water with Jane, but it's her encounter with Tom that may turn out to be the biggest mistake of her life.

episodes.title: Fizz Ed
episodes.summary: When Lawndale High suffers a budget crisis, the cure may be worse than the disease.

episodes.title: Sappy Anniversary
episodes.summary: Should Daria be mad at Tom for forgetting their anniversary, or mad at herself for being mad?

episodes.title: Fat Like Me
episodes.summary: The Fashion Club is thrown into crisis by the unthinkable: moderate chubbiness.

episodes.title: Camp Fear
episodes.summary: Daria and Quinn attend a camp reunion where a greased watermelon lies in wait.

episodes.title: The Story of D
episodes.summary: Daria decides to submit a short story for publication -- but she's not the submissive type.

episodes.title: Lucky Strike
episodes.summary: Lawndale High's teachers go out on strike and, amazingly, the students notice.

episodes.title: Art Burn
episodes.summary: Jane learns that when it comes to art, imitation is the most profitable form of flattery.

episodes.title: One J at a Time
episodes.summary: Quinn has decided she needs a steady boyfriend, and the winnowing process could take years.

episodes.title: Life in the Past Lane
episodes.summary: Jane dates a guy who's a little behind the times say, half a century.

episodes.title: Aunt Nauseam
episodes.summary: Daria's aunt comes to visit, because the family's not dysfunctional enough already.

episodes.title: Prize Fighters
episodes.summary: Daria's competing for an academic award. Will she be forced to show enthusiasm?

episodes.title: My Night at Daria's
episodes.summary: Daria ponders whether having a relationship must necessarily involve touching another human being.

episodes.title: Boxing Daria
episodes.summary: Daria becomes obsessed with a big carton. Who wouldn't?
